raceinfo_chi.Course: B 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, gave ground from the 300M. (See Incident Report)
Substantial blood.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(2W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。自三百米處起墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）
氣管內有很多血。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W3W3W) Tracked leaders out wide without cover, effort to challenge winner 500m out, travelled strongly to join winner 200m out, weakened final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W3W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處發力，對頭馬展開挑戰。末段走勢強勁，二百米處追上頭馬。最後五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat outside the lead, lay in in the Straight, limited response. (See Incident Report)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側。直路上內閃。末段對催策反應平平。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Mid-field, ridden along into home straight and unable to hold position, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置。入直路時受催策，未能保持位置。轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace, nothing extra in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。直路上再無餘力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Settled wide in last few dropping to last about 900M out, made no further impression from a similar position into home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 居最後數位之內，走外疊。約九百米處墮居包尾位置。入直路時居相若位置，其後再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Soon taken back to worse than midfield, lost cover 3-wide rounding home bend dropping to last into straight, kept on under pressure past well-beaten horses.
(Sustained a cut to its right front leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a cut to its right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 瞬即留居中間之後位置。轉直路彎時走第三疊，失去遮擋。入直路時墮居包尾位置。在催策下保持走勢，末段超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。
（右前腿割傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, only one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。在催策下僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W3W) Checked shortly after start, remained in last few to straight, shifted wide for a run making home turn but unable to quicken to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W3W) 起步後不久勒避。入直路前仍居最後數位之內。轉直路彎時移出外疊取位，但未能加速展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Away only fairly, from pole position settled in the box-seat trail, closed off just fairly when shaken up.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘僅屬一般，居包廂位置。末段在催策下衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Mid-division, had to angle out for a run 300m out, soon lost ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置。三百米處須向外移出取位，瞬即墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden to chase leaders 500m out, lacked pace to challenge, weakened final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。未能增速以展開挑戰。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Made contact at start, raced at tail, 7 lengths or so back in the middle stages, passed some tired runners final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步時與他駒互相觸碰。居包尾位置，中段落後約七個馬位。最後四百米超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W) Began awkwardly, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W) 出閘笨拙，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W) Bumped out of stalls, raced in rear, some headway on bend, no extra final 200m, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居後列。直路彎略為追前。最後二百米再無餘力。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Taken back early, sat at the rear on the rail, saved ground, made some headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 早段留居後列，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Sat worse than midfield, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, rail position in mid-field, driven 500m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 起步時向內斜跑及發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Settled in midfield on rail, kept on in home straight until fading steadily inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路上保持走勢，直至最後二百米逐漸力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Shifted in on jumping and bumped, taken back to race at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, failed to make any progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 躍出時向內斜跑及與對手互相碰撞，留居包尾位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Mid-field in rail position, good and smooth headway on final bend, strong run to lead 150m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎順勢追前甚多。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先，其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Shifted in and bumped at start, raced in rear, switched for clear run top of home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 起步時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居後列。直路初轉換跑線以望空。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W2W) Crowded on jumping, raced in midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 躍出時受擠迫，居中間位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Sat towards rear, always at the back, not much found.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 沿途居後列。末段無甚餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Taken back form gate 13, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 自第十三檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, taken back to race at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Slowly away, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢。沿途居包尾位置。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W6W) Sat on pace 2 wide, wide no cover from 1000M, nothing extra in the Straight.
(Laceration To Right Hind Cannon.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W6W) 居前列，走第二疊。自一千米處起走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路上再無餘力。
（右後腿管骨部位割傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W4W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, stayed on late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W4W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Sat near the rear 2 wide, never quickened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居後列，走第二疊。從未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Crowded shortly after start losing ground, soon recovered to 9th towards rear on rail, forced to steady when pace slackened onto first turn, made no impression in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 起步後不久受擠迫及失地，瞬即恢復走勢，居後列第九位，走內欄。進入首個彎位步速減慢時被迫收慢。末段毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Taken back from gate 9, raced 3 wide with cover towards rear, moved a bit closer on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 自第九檔出閘，留居後列，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎略為追近。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, settled at the rear early, moved closer to midfield passing 800M, held up 400M to 300M before closing off fairly. No threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，早段居後列。跑過八百米處時追近至中間位置。四百米處至三百米處之間受困，其後衝刺一般，未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Slowly away, made up some ground to race rear of mid-field, under pressure 500m out, bumped between rivals 200m out, no real impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘緩慢，略為追前以居中間之後位置。五百米處受催策。二百米處在對手之間發生碰撞。未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W4W) Average to begin, raced at rear on outer, 8 lengths back in the middle stages, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
Lost right front plate.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W4W) 出閘一般，居後列，走外疊。中段落後八個馬位。入直路時大外疊。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。
右前蹄鐵脫落。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W5W) Raced very wide in rear without cover, some headway on bend, pushed along wide into home straight, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W5W) 居後列，走大外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎略為追前。入直路時受推策，走外疊。衝刺良佳，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W) Sat behind mid, traveled nicely, responded nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走勢良佳。末段對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Bumped exiting stalls, driven along and outpaced early stages, pushed along widest into home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W4W5W) Moderately away, raced in midfield on the outside, made contact near 700M, peaked turning in, weakened early in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W4W5W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走外疊。接近七百米處時發生觸碰。入直路時未能再增速，直路早段轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W7W) Did not show sufficient pace early stages to hold a more forward position as intended, made a wide move from the rear at middle of the turn before closing off fairly in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W7W) 早段未能展現足夠前速以佔取如賽前部署般較為靠前的位置。直路彎中段沿外疊自後列發力上前，其後在直路上衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Well there from a poor draw, came to share the pace rounding home bend gaining slender lead upon straightening, led until finding no extra 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘，居好位。轉直路彎時上前並排領先。入直路時領先些微距離。領先直至一百五十米處再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Average to begin, positioned 2 wide, 4 lengths or so back, carried wider turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘一般，落後約四個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時被帶出較外疊。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 4-1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 起步時向內斜跑，發生觸碰，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四個半馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後二百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Moderately away, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, same position on turn, showed limited response early in straight, kept on same pace until approaching final 50M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘普通，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平。保持同速直至趨近最後五十米，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Began awkwardly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, hung out in the home turn, one pace when asked. (See incident report.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。直路彎外閃。在催策下保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide in midfield early, dropped towards rear 600M, 4 lengths or so back turning in, closed off well without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，早段居中間位置，走第二疊。六百米處墮居後列。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段衝刺良佳，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Bumped and lost balance exiting stalls, tracked leaders, short of room early in home straight, clear run 200m out, lacked pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時被碰撞，失去平衡，跟隨領先馬匹。直路早段空位不足。二百米處望空。未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, under pressure 500m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受催策。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide better than midfield, wider turning in, made some progress early in straight, peaked on run 100M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走更外疊。直路初略為追前。一百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Settled worse than midfield on the rail, made minor progress. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Ridden along in last few on rail after moderate start, baulked behind runners from the 800M and forced to check 700M out, fought on steadily from one of the widest into straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通，受催策，居最後數位內，走內欄。自八百米處起在馬匹之後受困，七百米處被迫勒避。入直路時為走最外疊馬匹之一，持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Ridden to midfield some 5L back in 6th about 1100M out, slightly worse rounding home bend, kept on same pace without quickening under pressure in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 受催策，居中間位置。約千一米處居第六位，落後約五個馬位。轉直路彎時略為墮後。直路上受催策，但未能加速，保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Bumped shortly after the start, raced at rear on the inside, angled out 500M, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, one-paced thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居後列，走內疊。五百米處向外移出。直路早段略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W4W) Sat towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居後列。入直路時受推策，走外疊。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, sent forward to race in 2nd early, allowed rival to cross near 800M, 4 lengths back on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，早段受催策上前居第二位。接近八百米處時讓對手過頭。直路彎落後四個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W3W3W) Moderately away, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, moved closer after passing 1050M, 2 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened inside final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W3W3W) 出閘普通，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。跑過一千零五十米處後追近，入直路時落後兩個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, taken widest final bend, no extra final 150m and gave ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。直路彎被帶出最外疊。最後一百五十米再無餘力及墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, under pressure 400m out, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。四百米處受催策。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W4W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居後列，走第二疊。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W2W) Settled midfield, traveled only fairly, minor progress made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 居中間位置，走勢僅屬一般。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (6W3W3W) Moderately away from gate 11, unable to slot in, trapped wide in midfield, 3 lengths or so back turning in, weakened early in straight when hard run took toll. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(6W3W3W) 自第十一檔出閘普通，未能切入內欄，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。耗力太多，直路早段轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Away with them, taken back to race at rear, 7 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 與對手同步出閘，其後留居後列。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Away well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, peaked and headed 300M, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時領先一個馬位。三百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide in midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Settled one back in 3rd on rail within 2L of pace, angled out for a run entering home straight and faded gradually out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居第三位，落後領放馬不足兩個馬位，走內欄。入直路時向外移出取位。其後逐漸力竭，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Began well, raced prominently on the outside, a length back turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked 100M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後一個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat at rear, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居後列。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, ridden along from 550m out, short of room final 250m, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。自五百五十米處起受催策。最後二百五十米空位不足，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began only fairly, taken back to race towards rear on the inside, moved a bit closer in the middle stages, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居後列，走內疊。中段略為追近。入直路後固守內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Raced in rear after bumped leaving stalls, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘時發生碰撞，其後居後列。入直路時受推策，走外疊。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Sat behind midfield, was taken wider near the 900M, switched out entering the Straight, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 居中間之後位置。接近九百米處時被帶出較外疊。入直路時向外移出。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Lifted front feet on jumping and away tardily, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run in straight, eased final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 躍出時一對前腳並舉，出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上未能望空。最後一百米收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to track leaders, challenged and every chance from 300m out, ran on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘後受催策以跟隨領先馬匹。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。以佳勢上前，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Outpaced in rear, hung in and lost balance 900m out, ridden top of home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，未能跟上步速。九百米處內閃及失去平衡。直路初受催策。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (1W1W1W1W) Clean jump, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘俐落，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持佳勢，跑入季席，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced towards rear, 8 lengths or so back turning in, made very good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑及被觸碰，居後列。入直路時落後約八個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W1W2W) Wide early, across to track leader, pressed leader top of home straight, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W1W2W) 早段走外疊，切入以跟隨領放馬。直路初追迫領放馬，最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, travelled smoothly and switched for clear run 400m out, challenged and every chance in home straight, no extra final 100m, checked close home.
(Sustained a small abrasion to the right knee.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a small abrasion to the right knee.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。走勢暢順，四百米處轉換跑線以望空。直路上展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。最後一百米再無餘力，接近終點時勒避。
（右膝輕微擦傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 3 wide, a length or so back, 2 wide from 800M, same margin back on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，落後約一個馬位，走第三疊。自八百米處起走第二疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Sat behind midfield 3 wide, closed off nicely, no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。末段衝刺良佳，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sluggish start, rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居中間位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現，速度不足以展開挑戰。

raceinfo_chi.Course: B 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Quickly into stride, sent forward to take the lead, shared lead with rival turning in, peaked and headed 200M, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 展步迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時與對手並排領先。二百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat just behind the leaders, unable to quicken in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置。直路上未能加速。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Began smartly from gate 1, raced in 2nd, 1-1/2L back turning in, showed very good response in straight, took the lead approaching 100M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居第二位。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路上對催策反應甚佳。趨近一百米處時取得領先。末段保持佳勢至終點，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Made contact at start, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, stayed on evenly to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 起步時被觸碰，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速。保持穩勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, headed top of home straight, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。直路初被超越。末段持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well from the widest draw, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 100M, stayed on evenly to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速及被超越。保持穩勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Jumped well from a wide draw, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/4L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the first two final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一又四分一個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W3W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, unable to make up ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, unable to secure clear run until 150m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。未能望空直至一百五十米處。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat at the rear, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, never in contention. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W) 自外檔出閘後留後。從未參與競逐。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, travelled smoothly into home straight, ran on well to edge ahead final 50m in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹，入直路時走勢暢順。走勢良佳，最後五十米取得領先，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W) Out with rest, raced in midfield on the outside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, closed off well to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。衝刺良佳，取得第四名，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Made contact with the gate on jumping, sat rear, made some ground from behind.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 躍出時觸碰閘廂，居後列。末段自後列略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W2W) Mid-field, hampered when looking to make headway 200m out, never a threat after.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W2W) 居中間位置。二百米處在嘗試上前之際受阻礙。其後從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W3W) Sat midfield, raced wide throughout, weakened late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W3W) 居中間位置，沿途走外疊，末段轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W3W) Waited with in rear from high draw, stayed on down the outside final 150m, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後居後列，留力候上。最後一百五十米沿外疊保持走勢，未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, still in rear top of home straight, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居後列。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W3W) Sat at the rear on the rail, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W3W) 居後列，走內欄。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled on the rail just off the speed, threw his head about in the middle stages, lacked a finish effort over the final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居領放馬稍後位置，走內欄。中段搶口。末段衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W2W) Settled midfield, held up at the Turn, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W2W) 居中間位置。直路彎受困。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Patiently ridden from high draw, keen, stayed on late, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 自最外檔出閘，留力候上。搶口。末段保持走勢。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W) Broke well but soon taken back to last and waited with while travelling keenly, did not find much room between runners until running on too late inside the 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W) 出閘迅速，但瞬即留居包尾位置，留力候上，搶口。在馬匹之間空位不足，一百米處追前，但為時已晚。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Settled midfield, raced wide, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Began well from gate 12, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made very good progress in straight to take 2nd, nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 自第十二檔出閘迅速，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W2W3W) Held up last, still in last pair top of home straight, passed a few tiring rivals late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W2W3W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居最後兩位之內。末段超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Keen and pressed leader, one of three that raced clear to halfway, weakened 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 搶口，追迫領放馬。為半程前拋離馬群的三駒之一。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat midfield, traveled smoothly, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。走勢暢順。以穩勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced behind midfield on the outside, very wide turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 自外檔出閘，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Rear of mid-field, one paced under pressure final 300m, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 居中間之後位置。最後三百米在催策下保持同速。未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled towards rear in 9th or 8th, switched wide for a run into straight, made short-lived effort at about the 200M, made no further impression closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列第八或第九位。入直路時移出外疊取位。約二百米處一度發力，末段再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W) Sat towards the rear on the rail, made ground along the rail.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。末段沿欄追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Shifted in and bumped leaving stalls, tracked pace out wide without cover, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 出閘時向內斜跑及與對手互相碰撞，跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W5W) Shifted in abruptly and bumped heavily out of stalls, raced wide in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W5W) 出閘時急促向內斜跑及發生大力碰撞，居後列，走外疊。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, sat behind midfield, held up over the concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。末段受困。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Raced in rear after slowly away, some headway halfway out, made up some late ground against far rail.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘緩慢，居後列。半程時略為追前。末段沿外欄略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Tracked pace, took closer order from halfway but three wide, faded final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。自半程起進佔較接近位置，但走第三疊。最後二百五十米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat last 2 wide, made minor progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居包尾位置，走第二疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, some headway on bend, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。直路彎略為追前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Slightly slow out and bumped, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, showed limited response early in straight, awkwardly placed near 150M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘稍慢，被碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。直路初對催策反應平平。接近一百五十米處時處於窘境。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, still in rear top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居後列。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Commenced well, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, closed off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure 400m out, short of room 250m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間位置。四百米處受催策。二百五十米處空位不足。未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Made contact shortly after start, taken back to race at rear, 5 to 6 lengths back, same margin back on turn, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久發生觸碰。留居後列，落後五至六個馬位。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, ran on strongly to lead close home and hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。其後以勁勢上前，接近終點時取得領先，保住勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Mid division, under pressure 600m out, switched wide for clear run 400m out, short-lived effort 200m out, unable to sustain.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。六百米處受催策。四百米處移出外疊以望空。二百米處一度發力，其後無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W1W1W) Began awkwardly and made contact, sent forward to take the early lead, headed 1100M, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader in the middle stages, peaked early in straight, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，與對手互相觸碰，早段受催策上前，取得領先。千一米處被超越。中段落後領放馬一至兩個馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/2L turning in, peaked and headed 200M, weakened final 100M.
Jockey dropped whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個半馬位。二百米處未能再加速，被超越。最後一百米轉弱。
騎師跌掉馬鞭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Settled in mid-field, ridden along towards centre of course 400m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;居中間位置。四百米處在跑道中央受催策。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slightly slow out, raced in midfield on rail, 3 lengths or so back, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘稍慢，居中間位置，落後約三個馬位，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W3W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
(Jockey dropped whip near 200M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。
（騎師於接近二百米處時跌掉馬鞭。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （騎師於接近二百米處時跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, set strong pace, headed top of home straight, bumped and lost balance 250m out, well beaten.
(Lost right hind plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，以快步速領放。直路初被超越。二百五十米處被碰撞，失去平衡。所負甚遠。
（失去右後蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began awkwardly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Sluggish start, ridden along from stalls to lead, kicked 300m out, headed 150m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 起步緩慢，受催策取得領先。三百米處加速。一百五十米處被超越。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Chased the leader, gave ground passing the 300M, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 追趕領放馬。跑過三百米處時墮退。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, sent forward to take the lead, shared lead with rival turning in, peaked and headed 200M, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，受催策上前領放。入直路時與對手並排領先。二百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Sat behind the lead, nothing extra in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 居領放馬之後。直路上再無餘力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W1W1W) Ridden to soon take up running onto back straight setting a sound pace, led the field until finding no extra over 200M out, lost a placing late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W1W1W) 受催策，進入對面直路時瞬即取得領先，以快步速領放。保持領先直至二百米處再無餘力。末段失去季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W1W) Made running and set fast pace, challenged from 150m out, responded well, headed only close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W1W) 以快步速領放。自一百五十米處起受挑戰。對催策反應良佳，僅於接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well and led on the rail, kept on until weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，沿欄領放。保持走勢直至最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Began well, positioned 2 wide, a length or so back, there to turn, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 出閘迅速，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Sat handy 2 wide, failed to quicken in the straight. (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 居前列，走第二疊。直路上未能加速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Fast into stride, raced prominently on the inside, allowed the rival to cross near 500M, a length or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 展步迅速，居前列，走內疊。接近五百米處時讓對手過頭，入直路時落後約一個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, made some progress in straight to take a place, no threat to the first two. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上略為追前，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure to hold position 800m out, ran on well in home straight but always held by winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。八百米處在催策下保持位置。直路上以佳勢上前，但一直落後頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in front of midfield, minor progress made, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置。略為上前。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W) Crowded start, unable to slot in, trapped wide in midfield on the outside, slightly taken back approaching 700M, found cover near 650M, 6-1/2L back turning in, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W) 起步時受擠迫，未能切入，居中間位置，走外疊。趨近七百米處時稍為留後。接近六百五十米處時取得遮擋。入直路時落後六個半馬位。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W3W3W) Began well, raced 3 wide, a length or so back, no cover throughout, 2 lengths or so back turning in, weakened early in straight when hard run took toll. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W3W3W) 出閘迅速，落後約一個馬位，走第三疊，沿途沒有遮擋。入直路時落後約兩個馬位。耗力太多，直路早段轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat next to the lead, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側。衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, ridden along 500m out, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。五百米處受催策。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat on pace, gave ground gradually inside 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居前列。最後三百米逐漸墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide, a length or so back, similar position on turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘迅速，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, saved grounds in the turn, limited response when asked. (See incident report.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。受催策時反應一般。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Sat just off pace, one pace to the line. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 居領放馬稍後位置。保持同速至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Raced in rear after awkward start, had to wait for run turning into home straight, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居後列。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Sat in front of midfield, had difficulty obtaining clear running entering the Straight, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 居中間之前位置。入直路時難以望空。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, under pressure to hold position from 650m out, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。自六百五十米處起在催策下保持位置。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W4W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, wide throughout, pushed along widest into home straight, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W4W) 早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。沿途走外疊。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (4W2W4W) Bumped shortly after start, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, very wide into straight, finished off very strongly to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(4W2W4W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。衝刺凌厲，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W2W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the inside, angled out after passing 400M, unable to obtain clear run in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內疊。跑過四百米處後向外移出。直路上未能望空。（見競賽事件報告。）

raceinfo_chi.Course: B 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Sat off pace near center, one pace when asked. (See Incident Report)
Jockey dropped whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;居領放馬之後，靠近跑道中央競跑。在催策下保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）
騎師跌掉馬鞭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, good headway final bend, short-lived challenge early in home straight, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎以佳勢上前。直路初一度發力展開挑戰。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Ridden forward from the outside barrier, sat on pace 3 wide no cover, kept on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘，受催策上前，居前列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。末段走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W3W) Broke well and ridden early before settling in 3rd mostly within 2L of pace, commenced move home bend reaching 2nd into straight but unable to threaten the winner throughout.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘迅速，早段受催策，其後大多居第三位，落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位。直路彎開始上前，入直路時進佔第二位，但沿途未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W3W4W) Settled down ahead of midfield but was caught racing wide without cover, responded well early straight and challenged for the lead but run ended 100M and faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W3W4W) 居中間之前位置，但走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路初對催策反應良佳，爭奪領先，但一百米處無以為繼，力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W2W) Began smartly, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out 350M, kept on well in straight to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。三百五十米處向外移出。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat just behind the leaders, just one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置。在催策下僅保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W) Settled back in rear from wide draw, angled left over 200m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列。二百米處向外移出。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (4W2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, commenced move out wide from 600m out, widest into home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(4W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。自六百米處起開始發力，走外疊。入直路時走最外疊。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out approaching 350M, closed off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。趨近三百五十米處時向外移出。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Settled in midfield, came under pressure onto home bend, one of the widest into straight, ran on to assert authority close to home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間位置。開始轉直路彎時受催策。入直路時為走最外疊的馬匹之一。追前，接近終點時控制大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Began moderately settling towards rear, kept on one pace without quickening from a similar position into home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘普通，居後列。入直路時保持同速，未能自相若位置加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Started well from wide draw but soon taken back to race in rear, stayed on well down the outside final 200m and passed several rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，但瞬即留居後列。最後二百米保持佳勢，走外疊，超越數匹對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W3W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, ran on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。保持走勢，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (7W2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, stayed on fairly well when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(7W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。在催策下保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, travelled smoothly into home straight, ran on strongly, edged ahead final 50m in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。入直路時走勢暢順。末段以勁勢追前。五十米處取得領先，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W1W) Settled midfield 2 wide, closed off without threatening. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W1W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段展開衝刺，但未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Close up early, gradually drifted 3L back to 4th when tempo increased in back straight, gained 3rd from a tiring runner onto home bend and fought on steadily in home straight, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 早段緊隨領先馬匹。對面直路上步速加快時逐漸墮居第四位，落後三個馬位。開始轉直路彎時超越一匹漸呈疲態的對手，進佔第三位。直路上持續力拼。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Mid-field, checked briefly 500m out, one paced under pressure and unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間位置。五百米處一度勒避。在催策下保持同速，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Settled towards rear on the rail, saved ground in the turn, made some ground in the final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。最後一百五十米略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat 2 wide outside to the leader, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側，走第二疊。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Began well from a wide draw, sent forward to race prominently, 3 wide, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列，走第三疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能再加速。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Led on the rail, gave ground in the Straight. (See Incident Report) (Performance unacceptable, must trial)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 沿欄領先。直路上墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）（表現難以接受，必須試閘及格。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to lead, kept on until weakened final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。保持走勢直至最後七十五米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, pressed on entering home straight, closed down final 100m, headed late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭。進入直路時受催策。最後一百米被追近。末段被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced prominently, 2 wide, a length or so back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走第二疊。入直路時落後約一個馬位。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped nicely and led, weakened final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，取得領先。最後五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well and led, kept on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，取得領先。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced towards rear, 5 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時被碰撞，居後列。入直路時落後約五個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Settled towards rear, limited response when asked, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 居後列。對催策反應平平。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began moderately, settled in rear, saved ground rounding home bend, ran on in straight to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘普通，居後列。轉直路彎時走內疊節省腳程。直路上追前，接近終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, ran on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Held up last after slowly away, rail position throughout, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，留居包尾位置。沿途走內欄。未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide towards rear, hampered near 700M, 6 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘普通，居後列，走第二疊。接近七百米處時受阻礙。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) 3-wide in midfield early stages, taken back towards rear in 8th into back straight, hung in and unbalanced causing interferences 500M out, kept on same pace from 7th into straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 早段居中間位置，走第三疊。入對面直路時留居後列第八位。五百米處內閃及失去平衡，造成干擾。入直路時居第七位，保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W) Average to begin, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run until approaching final 100M, finished off strongly to score by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W) 出閘普通，落後領放馬兩個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至趨近一百米處。衝刺強勁，以一馬頸位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced prominently early, 1 out 1 back in the middle stages, no clear run early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，早段居前列。中段居第二疊第二位。直路早段未能望空。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced better than midfield on the inside, easy run to turn, finished off well to take 2nd, just beaten by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎前走勢輕鬆。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，僅以一馬頸位見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Recovered from sluggish start to race in mid-field against rail, some headway 300m out, soon unable to sustain, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步緩慢，恢復走勢，居中間位置，走內欄。三百米處略為追前，瞬即無以為繼 。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover off pace, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居領放馬之後，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W) Sat outside lead, kept on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Jumped with them, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速，最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Bounded leaving stalls and lost ground, raced in last trio, no response to pressure home straight, eased when well held final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘時向上跳躍及失地，居最後三位內。直路上對催策毫無反應。最後一百五十米在落後頗遠之際收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Began awkwardly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths back, wider turning in, made good progress in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，落後五個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路上追前頗多，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled worse than midfield, raced ungenerously in the early and middle stages, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。早段及中段走勢欠順。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Mid-field, ridden when short of room and switched 300m out, unable to quicken and little impression after.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。三百米處受催策時空位不足，轉換跑線。其後未能增速，無甚表現。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Made contact at start, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, travelled keenly in the middle stages, 3 lengths back turning in, showed limited response in straight, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。中段搶口。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路上對催策略有反應。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began only fairly, settled ahead of midfield along the inside, failed to run on when asked top of the straight. Never a threat. (Jockey : his mount was reluctant to improve between runners during the race.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路初受催策時未能追前。從未能構成威脅。（騎師表示，坐騎陣上不願在馬匹之間推進。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled just worse than midfield on rail, baulked for a run after straightening, obtained clear run over 150M out, finished off the race well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間稍後位置，走內欄。入直路後受困。一百五十米處望空。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) In rear after slow start, some headway under pressure but never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。在催策下略為追前，但從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W3W4W) Waited with in rear, hampered and carried very wide by rival entering home straight, stayed on well and just failed to get up for second (finished third, placed second).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時被對手阻礙及帶出大外疊。末段保持佳勢，僅未能取得第二名。（第三名過終點，獲升為第二名。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Waited with in rear, stayed on well down the outside from over 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。自二百米處起在外疊以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Mid-field, raced wide, stayed on final 200m to snatch fourth late, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，走外疊。最後二百米保持走勢。末段進佔第四位，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped awkwardly, raced at rear on the outside, 7 lengths back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Gradually taken back after beginning from a poor draw settling in last few, 3-wide rounding home bend, ran past well-beaten horses closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 自外檔出閘後逐漸留居最後數位之內。轉直路彎時走第三疊。末段超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled handy on the rail, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。走勢尚可。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W5W) Waited with in rear, pushed along 400m out, some headway final 200m, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W5W) 居後列，留力候上。四百米處受推策。最後二百米略為追前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W1W) Gradually settled in midfield on rail, switched out for a run 250M out, fought on steadily under pressure to snatch 3rd final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W1W) 逐漸居中間位置，走內欄。二百五十米處向外移出以取位。在催策下持續力拼，最後數步取得季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。以佳勢追前，但未能與頭馬抗衡。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, pushed along wide into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, made contact near 1000M and 850M, 5 lengths or so back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。接近一千米處及八百五十米處時兩度被對手觸碰。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield, checked near the 150M, never a threat (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置。接近一百五十米處時勒避。從未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W4W) Began well, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, angled out 500M, very wide turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W4W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時走大外疊。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Raced wide from high draw, improved to track pace before halfway, pushed along 400m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 自第十檔出閘，走外疊。半程前推進上前以跟隨領放馬。四百米處受推策。最後二百米轉弱。

raceinfo_chi.Course: B 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W2W) Jumped well from gate 1, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on the inside, commenced move approaching 400M, showed very good response in straight, took the lead 100M, kept on strongly to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬兩個馬位，走內疊。趨近四百米處時開始上前。直路上對催策反應甚佳。一百米處取得領先。保持勁勢至終點，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Stayed close enough to leaders throughout, worked into the race well passing 400M but couldn't muster enough mid-straight and weakened out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 沿途保持緊隨領先馬匹。跑過四百米處時以佳勢上前，但直路中段加速力不足。轉弱，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Dipped at start before settling just over 2L back in 4th on rail, angled out 500M out for a run into straight, tightened and lost position 200M out and ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘時將頭低俯，其後居第四位，落後稍逾兩個馬位，走內欄。五百米處向外移出，入直路時取得空位。二百米處受緊迫及失位。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, settled in rear of mid-field, ridden along 600m out, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置。六百米處受催策。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, switched out in the Straight, ran on nicely, just held on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。直路上向外移出。末段以佳勢上前，僅保住冠軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, struggled to hold position on bend, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。直路彎難以保持位置。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Raced wide in mid-field, headway into contention 200m out, stayed on between horses despite being tight for room.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊。二百米處上前爭勝。儘管在馬匹之間受緊迫，但保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W1W) Crowded and bumped at start, rail position in mid-field, under pressure 400m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫及發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處受催策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W3W4W) Waited with in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, some late gains but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受催策，走最外疊。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted in and bumped at start, tracked leaders, pushed along 500m out, checked 350m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時向內斜跑及被碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受推策。三百五十米處勒避，未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Sat worse than midfield 2 wide, made late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared after passing 150M, kept on same pace to 50M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空。跑過一百五十米處後望空。保持同速至五十米處。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W4W) Bumped leaving stalls, raced in mid-field, good headway final bend but forced wide, ran on well home straight despite wandering under pressure, led final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，居中間位置。直路彎以佳勢上前，但被迫走外疊。儘管在催策下走勢欠規矩，但在直路上以佳勢上前。最後一百米領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W4W4W) Away okay and restrained early to be 3 wide with cover, with the slow pace commenced a long wide surging run around 800m, knuckled down to the task in the final stages to get the job done.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W4W4W) 出閘尚可，早段受約束，走第三疊，有遮擋。賽事步速緩慢，八百米處開始長距離衝刺，走外疊。末段力拼上前，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled smoothly, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走勢暢順。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W1W2W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide behind midfield early, found rail near 600M, saved ground on turn, finished off well to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W1W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，早段居中間之後位置，走第二疊。接近六百米處時移入內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。衝刺良佳，取得第四名，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Sat towards rear on the rail, saved ground in the home turn, found no extra under the pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。受催策時再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, save grounds in the turn, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, struggled to hold position from 600m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自六百米處起難以保持位置。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W2W3W) Pressed leader, under pressure 550m out to hold position, taken wider final bend, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W2W3W) 追迫領放馬。五百五十米處受催策以保持位置。直路彎移出較外疊。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Prominent, ridden turning into home straight, weakened 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 居前列。入直路時受催策。三百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide better than midfield early, dropped to midfield after 900M, 5 lengths or so back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W) 出閘迅速，早段居中間之前位置，走第二疊。過了九百米處後墮居中間位置。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, weakened from the 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。自二百五十米處起轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Ridden along from gate 1 to lead, headed and weakened last 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，在催策下取得領先。最後二百米被超越，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Stayed close enough to leaders in the 5th spot, kept on at same pace turning home, raced in restricted room 200M for some distance and failed to run on after.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹，居第五位。轉直路彎時保持同速。二百米處在一段途程上在窄位競跑。其後未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Pressed forward under 10lb claimer, chased leader going into home turn, fought hard to stay in contention early straight, weakened final 100M. (Jockey reminded to ride out to the finish.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 在獲減十磅的騎師胯下受催策上前，入直路彎時追趕領放馬。直路初力拼以保持爭逐機會，最後一百米轉弱。（騎師被提醒她有責任全力催策坐騎至終點。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 50M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat behind the leaders 2 wide, kept on nicely for 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居領先馬匹之後，走第二疊。末段保持佳勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled smoothly, responded nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 在催策下領放。走勢暢順。對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (2W4W) Settled handy, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(2W4W) 居前列。走勢尚可。末段以穩勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W2W) Sat handy, traveled fairly, closed off well but held up at the finishing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 居前列，走勢一般。衝刺良佳，但末段受困。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W3W3W) Tracked pace, improved to challenge 300m out, led 200m out, ran on strongly to go clear final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬。三百米處上前展開挑戰，二百米處取得領先。最後一百米走勢強勁，帶離對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Across from wide draw to lead, headed 300m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，切入領放。三百米處被超越。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in midfield, made steady headway under pressure after straightening, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。入直路後在催策下穩步上前。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W5W) Sat towards rear, angled out at the Turn, ran on evenly (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W5W) 居後列。直路彎向外移出。以穩勢上前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W3W) Sat last, held up rounding the Home Turn, picked off a few weakened rivals. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居包尾位置。轉直路彎時受困。超越部分已轉弱的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, some headway middle stages, under pressure 400m out, lacked pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。中段略為追前。四百米處受催策。速度不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W4W) From a wide draw taken back to race behind midfield, wide into straight, wound up strongly to get pretty close in the end.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W4W) 自外檔出閘後留居中間之後位置。入直路時走外疊。衝刺強勁，過終點時所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, forced to steady top of home straight, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。直路初被迫收慢。末段走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, held up early part of the Straight, ran on when in the clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受困。末段在望空下追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Prominent briefly and soon dropped to wide in worse than midfield, produced moderate short-lived effort early in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 一度居前列，瞬即墮居中間之後位置，走外疊。直路初一度發力，走勢普通。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，落後約五個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W5W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, kept chasing in the Straight, nothing extra final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路上持續追趕。最後五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Settled in last few and waited with, went wide into home straight, ran on under pressure down the centre of the track, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 居最後數位之內，留力候上。入直路時走外疊。直路上在跑道中央受催策上前。以末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Slowly away and checked soon after start, outpaced and detached from main body of runners, never competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘緩慢，其後瞬即勒避。未能跟上步速，被主馬群拋離。從未見具競爭力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W) Taken back from gate 12, raced 2 wide at rear, 7 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W3W) Out with rest, raced 3 wide slightly better than midfield, crowded approaching 1400M, 2 wide in the middle stages, inconvenienced by the weakened horse near 450M, wide into straight, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍前位置，走第三疊。趨近千四米處時受擠迫。中段走第二疊。接近四百五十米處時受轉弱的對手妨礙。入直路時走外疊。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W1W1W) Held up last from wide draw, still plenty to do 300m out, stayed towards rail, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。三百米處仍落後甚遠，保持走內欄。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Sat handy, slightly weakened passing the 200M, closed off okay (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居前列。跑過二百米處時略為轉弱。末段衝刺尚可。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, waited with in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W3W5W) From draw 13 unable to slot in, raced 3-wide without cover in midfield throughout, couldn't keep up with rivals passing 250M, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W3W5W) 自第十三檔出閘後未能切入，沿途居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。跑過二百五十米處時未能跟上對手，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Slightly slow out and bumped, raced at tail, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 出閘稍慢，被碰撞，居包尾位置。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上追前甚多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W1W1W1W) Sat towards rear on the inside, there to turn, minor progress made in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W1W1W1W) 居後列。走內疊。直路彎前居相同位置，直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat towards rear, traveled smoothly, held up at the top of the Straight and again over the final 50M, could not be fully tested.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列，走勢暢順。直路初及最後五十米兩度受困，未能全力施為。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Three wide in mid-field, taken wider 500m out, tended to hang right in home straight, unable to improve position.
(Jockey dropped whip at 200M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。五百米處被帶出較外疊。直路上傾向內閃，未能推進。
（於二百米騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, running into trouble top of home straight, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路初受阻，未能望空直至二百米處。最後二百米以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, lay in and never seriously tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。內閃，從未能真正施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W1W1W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, ridden along in the turn, never a threat. (See incident report.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎受催策，從未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Moderate start, gradually recovered to prominent position, one back in 2nd 2-wide rounding home bend, faded under pressure inside final 350M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘普通，逐漸恢復走勢，居前列。轉直路彎時居第二位，落後一個馬位，走第二疊。最後三百五十米在催策下力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (1W1W1W1W) Shifted in at start and bumped, sent forward to take the lead, enjoyed the easy lead in the middle stages, kept on very well after turning in, easily scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 起步時向內斜跑，被碰撞。受催策上前領放。中段輕鬆領放。入直路後保持甚佳走勢，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat off pace 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居領先馬匹之後，走第二疊。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Taken back after the start, settled at the back 7-8Ls off the pace, still plenty to do 400M, finished off well making good progress to take 4th close home
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 起步後留居後列，落後領放馬七至八個馬位。四百米處仍落後甚多。衝刺良佳，追前甚多，接近終點時取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Sat at the rear, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居後列。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, held up top of the Straight, never impress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路初受困，毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Waited with in rear, keen to halfway, angled wide for a run early in home straight, stayed on late but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。半程前搶口。直路早段移出外疊取位。末段保持走勢，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled within 2L of pace in 3rd on the rail, saved ground turning in for home but unable to sustain effort shortly upon straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居第三位，落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位，走內欄。入直路時走內欄節省腳程，但入直路後不久無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Sat rear, raced rear, dashed on inside 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 沿途居後列。最後一百米加速上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W4W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段超越部分已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Fast break, outpaced and raced in rear, dropped to last place 700m out, pushed along 650m out, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，其後未能跟上步速，居後列。七百米處墮居包尾位置。六百五十米處受推策。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Waited with towards rear, still in rear top of home straight, blocked off when going for run 250m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍居後列。二百五十米處在嘗試取位時受困。未能收復失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W1W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, still in last pair turning into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。轉入直路時仍居最後兩位之內。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, good headway final bend, sustained headway to make run 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎追前甚多。持續上前，二百米處展開衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Niggled at early, soon obtained rails run in midfield in 7th, remained in a similar position into straight hugging the rail, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 早段受催策，瞬即佔取中間第七位，走內欄。入直路時保持相若位置，固守內欄。持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

raceinfo_chi.Course: B 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W2W) Tracked leaders against rail, travelled smoothly into home straight, ran on well to lead 100m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時走勢暢順。末段走勢良佳，一百米處帶頭。其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, had to check at the early stages, closed off nicely to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。早段須勒避。衝刺良佳，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, eye-catching headway from rear final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米自後列追前，走勢悅目。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Away ok and sat slightly worse than midfield 3 wide with cover, stayed at the same pace to the line when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 出閘尚可，居中間稍後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。末段在催策下保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, taken wider on bend, effort 350m out, not beaten far.
(Jockey dropped whip at 200M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎移出更外疊。三百五十米處發力。所負不遠。
（於二百米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress early in straight, no clear run approaching 150M, made no progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後留居包尾位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段追前甚多。趨近一百五十米處時未能望空，其後毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Moderately away, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out 350M, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。三百五十米處向外移出。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W3W) Commenced well, raced prominently, 3 wide, peaked on run approaching 400M, weakened and eased early in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W3W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走第三疊。趨近四百米處時未能再增速。直路早段轉弱，收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W2W) Made contact at start, raced 3 wide with no cover better than midfield, moved a bit closer on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened approaching final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎略為追近。直路初未能再增速。趨近一百米處時轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 2 lengths back, there to turn, kept on well early in straight, no extra final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 起步時與對手互相碰撞，居中間之前位置，落後兩個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段保持佳勢，最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Towards rear in race run at fast pace, weaved through runners to chase leaders 150m out, led on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 居後列，賽事步速甚快。一百五十米處在馬匹之間穿插上前，追趕領先馬匹。過終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W3W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover on pace, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W3W3W) 居前列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Made running, kicked 400m out, strong challenge from runner-up in home straight, stayed on well to hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 領放。四百米處加速。直路上受亞軍馬匹的強勁挑戰。保持佳勢，保住勝局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。
