runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, raced keenly in the early stages, gave ground notably in the Straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 在催策下取得領先。早段搶口。直路上顯著墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Worked through to sit just off the leader, pace very fast in the first half, asked for effort 300M but found nothing in a fading run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 在催策下緊隨領放馬，賽事前半程步速甚快。三百米處受催策，但末段力竭，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Bumped heavily at start, raced in midfield on the outside, 4 lengths back turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 起步時發生大力碰撞，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Bumped start, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, same position on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped leaving stalls, disputed led, clear leader top of home straight, headed by winner 250m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，爭奪領先。直路初領放。二百五十米處被頭馬超越。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Three wide in mid-field, pushed along widest into home straight, outpaced and left behind final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped at the start, from draw 11 moved up to track leader, all out final 400M but was readily held by the winner who was 4 runs unbeaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自第十一檔起步時發生碰撞，上前跟隨領放馬。最後四百米全力以赴，但一直落後四戰全勝的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W3W) Settled in last few from a wide barrier, came under pressure home bend swinging one of the widest into straight, ran on well down the centre of the track despite hanging in under pressure, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W3W) 自外檔出閘，居最後數位之內。直路彎受催策。入直路時向外移出，為走最外疊的馬匹之一。儘管在催策下內閃，但仍沿跑道中央以佳勢上前。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Crowded start, taken back to race at tail, saved ground on turn, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，留居包尾位置。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路上追前甚多。過終點時最為接近。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Held up last, still in rear travelling smoothly 300m out, short of room when trying to improve 200m out, finished off strongly through horses, eye-catcher.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;留居包尾位置。三百米處仍居後列，走勢暢順。二百米處在嘗試推進之際空位不足。末段在馬匹之間衝刺強勁。表現悅目。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Jumped on terms from draw 1, settled in a midfield position 3.5L away, little change at the turn and failed to finish off in the home straight. (Trainer - would be suited by being stepped up in distance for its next race.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，落後三個半馬位。轉直路彎時位置相若。直路上衝刺乏力。（練馬師告知小組，此駒下仗增程角逐應合發揮。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began only fairly from gate 1, raced towards rear on the inside, moved a bit closer along the rail on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。直路彎沿欄略為追近。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Shifted in and bumped leaving stalls, held up last, ridden along 600m out, short of room 400m out to 200m out, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘時向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，留居包尾位置。六百米處受催策。四百米處至二百米處空位不足。最後二百米以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Taken back from a wide barrier to last or near last, saved ground on rail turning in for home, only produced modest impression under pressure in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居包尾或接近包尾位置。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程。末段在催策下僅略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, under pressure 400m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處受催策。未能推進上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W1W) Sat worse than midfield, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W1W) 居中間之後位置。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Waited with in rear, pushed along 400m out, left behind final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。四百米處受推策。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Waited with towards rear, shuffled back after halfway, angled wide over 200m out, stayed on, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。半程後墮後。二百米處移出外疊。保持走勢，未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Settled rear, traveled okay, made steady ground late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，走勢不俗。末段以穩勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W2W3W) Waited with, under pressure in rear turning into home straight, strong run on wide outside final 150m, led close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W2W3W) 留力候上。轉入直路時居後列，受催策。最後一百五十米在外疊走勢強勁。接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W3W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, under pressure from the 450M, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W3W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。自四百五十米處起受催策。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Prominent chasing leader, fought hard in the straight to stay in contention, had difficulty obtaining clear running 100M but was beaten comfortably in the end.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居前列，追趕領放馬。直路上力拼，保持爭勝機會。一百米處難以望空，過終點時所負頗遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Sluggish getaway and crowded shortly after the start, made up decent late ground last 200M.
Lost right front plate.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，其後不久受擠迫。最後二百米追前甚多。
失去右前蹄的蹄鐵。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Taken forward from wide draw and tracked leader, challenged and every chance to 150m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘後上前，跟隨領放馬。其後展開挑戰，一百五十米處前已獲機會盡展所長，末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped exiting stalls, raced in touch with leaders, unable to hold position by 600m out, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，緊隨領先馬匹。六百米處未能保持位置。洩氣潰敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W1W) After 100m raced very awkwardly, became unbalanced and hung left, lost considerable ground in the process and quickly tailed off.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W1W) 跑了一百米後走勢非常笨拙，失去平衡及外閃，因而失地甚多，瞬即居包尾位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped on jumping, trapped very wide early, a length or so back, 2 wide from 900M, same margin back on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 躍出時發生碰撞，早段落後約一個馬位，走大外疊。自九百米處起走第二疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Settled handy, failed to respond when asked (See Incident Report).
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居前列。對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Settled in midfield early stages, drifted steadily backward to last few rounding home bend, made no further impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 早段居中間位置。轉直路彎時逐漸墮居最後數位之內。直路上再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W) Held up from wide draw, struggling and left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後留後。最後三百米掙扎上前，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, driven along 500m out, lost touch final 200m, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策。最後二百米被拋離。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Sat towards rear, commence to improve passing the 600M, made good ground in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 居後列。跑過六百米處時開始上前。直路上追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, sat rear, raced keenly in the middle stages, held up making the Home Turn, could not be fully tested when positioned close to heels.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。中段搶口。轉直路彎時受困。末段在靠近一駒後蹄時未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Wide throughout in mid-field, one paced under pressure, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，沿途走外疊。在催策下保持同速，未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sat towards the rear on the rail, made no ground
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。末段未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Waited with, clear run up rail and good headway from top of home straight, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 留力候上。自直路初起沿欄望空，追前甚多。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, settled midfield, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, stayed on steadily but no threat to front two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。保持穩勢，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Shifted out and bumped at start, made running, kicked 500m out, stuck to task, headed by winner 100m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，被碰撞。領放，五百米處加速。持續力拼，一百米處被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W1W1W) Led on the rail, traveled smoothly, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 沿欄領放，走勢暢順。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure 600m out, faded final 150m, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位置。六百米處受催策。最後一百五十米力竭，遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Bumped leaving stalls, showed good speed to lead, ridden along 250m out, headed by winner 150m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，展現甚佳前速以領放。二百五十米處受催策。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W4W4W) Wide throughout, mid-field, pushed along and lost place over 400m out, left behind final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W4W4W) 沿途居中間位置，走外疊。四百米處受推策，失位。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled smoothly, closed off well, had every chance (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 在催策下領放，走勢暢順。衝刺良佳，已獲機會盡展所長。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, settled midfield, one pace to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W4W1W) Shifted out at start and made contact, positioned 2 wide, 3 lengths or so back, commenced move 700M, took the lead approaching 500M, led by a length turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W4W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，落後約三個馬位，走第二疊。七百米處開始上前。趨近五百米處時取得領先。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後一百米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Travelled keenly at times mainly 3-wide without cover in midfield, circled the field home bend to be widest in 6th some 2L back into straight, soon found no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 大多居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋，不時搶口。直路彎繞過馬群。入直路時居第六位，落後約兩個馬位，走最外疊。瞬即再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Towards rear, wide into home straight, stayed on late, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列。入直路時走外疊。末段保持走勢，未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, nothing in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Sat midfield on the rail, stayed on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。末段保持佳勢。

raceinfo_chi.Course: B 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W2W) Mid-field, had to wait for run early in home straight, stayed on for pressure, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W2W) 居中間位置。直路早段須等待空位出現。末段在催策下保持走勢，未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (5W1W3W) Soon taken back for inside run, gained closer to 10th passing the 900M, commenced move entering home straight obtaining a run inside the 300M, ran on well under pressure to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(5W1W3W) 瞬即留後，走內疊。跑過九百米處時追近至第十位。入直路時開始發力。三百米處取位上前，其後在催策下以佳勢追前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Sat towards rear, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居後列。走勢尚可。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W) Jumped with the field, settled slightly worse than midfield, improved around the field 450M out, stayed on well to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍後位置。四百五十米處繞過馬群上前。末段保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, good headway final bend, sustained headway to challenge 200m out, no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎追前甚多。持續上前，二百米處展開挑戰，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W) Away well, raced 2 wide in 2nd, 3/4L back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時落後四分三個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Slightly slow out, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘稍慢。沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Checked leaving stalls, four wide in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 出閘時勒避，居後列，走第四疊。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。瞬即遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Raced in rear, driven along and outpaced from 700m out, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居後列。自七百米處起受催策，但未能跟上步速。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, unable to hold position halfway, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。半程時未能保持位置。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Made running, headed 300m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑。三百米處被超越。轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, hung out on bend, left behind in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路彎外閃。直路上被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Prominent early stages, gradually drifted some 2L back to 4th onto course proper, came under pressure to hold place inside final the 300M, weakened steadily closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;早段居前列。跑離分支直路時逐漸墮居第四位，落後約兩個馬位。最後三百米受催策以保持位置。末段逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Ridden along to lead, unable to hold position from 400m out, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;在催策下取得領先。自四百米處起未能保持位置。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W1W1W) Began moderately but soon joined leaders, took up running 900M out and rails run shortly afterwards, found no extra when headed 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W1W1W) 出閘普通，但瞬即追上領先馬匹。九百米處領先，其後不久走內欄。一百五十米處被超越後再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W1W) Raced against inside rail throughout, tracked leader, quickened to lead over 200m out, headed close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W1W) 沿途走內欄，跟隨領放馬。二百米處加速，取得領先。接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (4W2W2W) Inconvenienced at start, taken back to race 2 wide at rear, 6-1/2L back turning in, no clear run early in straight, cleared 150M, made good progress thereafter to make frame. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(4W2W2W) 起步時受妨礙，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後六個半馬位。直路初未能望空。一百五十米處望空。其後追前甚多，取得第四名。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, kept on nicely for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Showed good speed to lead, headed 600m out, remained prominent, dropped away quickly final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;展現甚快前速領放。六百米處被超越，仍居前列。最後三百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled strongly until 250M, slightly weakened.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 在催策下領放。走勢強勁直至二百五十米處。略為轉弱。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Jumped well and showed good speed to lead, kept on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，展現甚快前速領放。末段保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Made contact at start, raced at tail, 7 lengths back turning in, made very good progress in straight to take a place, good debut.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居包尾位置。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍。初出表現出色。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W2W) Tracked leading pair, challenged and every chance from 300m out, edged right, no extra final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W2W) 跟隨領先兩駒。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。向內斜跑。最後五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (8W1W1W) Used plenty of petrol to take up the leading position, stuck on ok considering the circumstances (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(8W1W1W) 花了不少氣力以取得領先。在此情況下走勢尚可。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (4W3W3W) Caught wide, forward move to race outside of leading pair at halfway, challenged and every chance from 200m out, no extra final 50m, just held third.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(4W3W3W) 走外疊。半程時上前，居領先兩駒外側。自二百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。最後五十米再無餘力。僅保住季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W4W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, commenced move out wide 500m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處開始發力，走外疊。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (5W3W3W) Tracked pace three wide, weakened quickly over 200m out.
(Jockey dropped whip at 150M.)
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(5W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。二百米處迅速轉弱。
（於一百五十米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）
（心律不正常。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （於一百五十米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Mid division against far rail, briefly tight for room when under pressure 300m out, stayed on but no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間位置，走外欄。三百米處受催策時一度受緊迫。末段保持走勢，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, pushed along to chase leaders 700m out, tight for room and lost balance 600m out, no extra close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。七百米處在推策下追趕領先馬匹。六百米處受緊迫，失去平衡。接近終點時再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W2W2W) Headway to race on leaders' quarters before halfway, challenged 300m out, every chance until no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W2W2W) 上前，半程前居領先馬匹外側競跑。三百米處展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會，直至最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped with them, raced prominently on the stands' side, hard ridden approaching 300M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;與對手同步躍出，居前列，靠近外欄競跑。趨近三百米處時受力策。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W1W) From draw 14 showed good pace early stages, went forward setting fast tempo, headed by pursuing rivals near 200M, faded late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W1W) 自第十四檔出閘，早段展現甚快前速，上前以甚快步速領放。接近二百米處時被緊追的對手超越，末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (2W2W) Sat outside the lead, kept on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(2W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持走勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Began awkwardly and bumped, raced behind midfield on the middle track, hard ridden approaching 300M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘笨拙及發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，在跑道中央競跑。趨近三百米處時受力策。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Began well, raced prominently, 2 wide, 1/4L back turning in, took the lead 300M, peaked and headed 150M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走第二疊。入直路時落後四分一個馬位。三百米處取得領先。一百五十米處未能再增速及被超越。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Tracked pace, hung left under pressure final 200m and outpaced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;跟隨領放馬。最後二百米在催策下外閃，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Settled in mid-field towards centre of course, effort 400m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;居中間位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。四百米處受催策。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Tracked leaders against rail, short of room against rail from 400m out, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;跟隨領先馬匹，走外欄。自四百米處起在外欄空位不足。殊不夠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat box-seat, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居包廂位置。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W3W) Sat behind the leaders on the rail, hung out rounding the Home Turn, eased down soon after. (Racing Manners Unacceptable, must trial) (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W3W) 居領先馬匹之後，走內欄。轉直路彎時外閃，其後瞬即收慢。（走勢難以接受，必須試閘及格。）（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W2W) Sat behind the lead, raced keenly, hung out rounding the Turn, weakened quickly passing 250M (Warning on racing manners).
Blood in mouth.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W2W) 居領放馬之後位置，搶口。轉直路彎時外閃。跑過二百五十米處時迅速轉弱。（小組就此駒的走勢發出警告。）
口內有血

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped with them, raced in 2nd, a length or so back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居第二位。入直路時落後約一個馬位。直路早段未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Made running, headed over 200m out, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 帶頭競跑。二百米處被超越。力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Moderately away, sat right behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed some response early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，緊隨領放馬，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策略有反應。一百五十米處未能再增速。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Average to begin, raced 3 wide in midfield, 3 lengths or so back, same position on turn, peaked early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，落後約三個馬位，走第三疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路早段未能再增速，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (6W2W2W) Moderately away from the widest draw, sent forward to race prominently on the outside, dropped towards rear on turn, emptied early in straight, eased thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(6W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘普通，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。直路彎墮居後列。直路早段力竭，其後收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat box seat, ran on nicely, just weakened final strides.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。末段以佳勢上前，僅在最後數步轉弱。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Pressed leader, quickened early in home straight to lead, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, tired closing stages and just held on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。直路早段加速，取得領先。二百米處加速帶離兩個馬位。末段呈現疲態，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped leaving stalls, tracked leaders, unable to secure clear run until 200m out and hung out, ran on well and beaten only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。未能望空直至二百米處，外閃。末段走勢良佳，僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace on the rail, traveled strongly, had every chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。走勢強勁。已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, switched for clear run top of home straight, shifted out and bumped 250m out, stayed on well but no further impression on front two late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路初轉換跑線以望空。二百五十米處向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞。保持佳勢，但末段未能進一步威脅頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began awkwardly, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run early in straight, cleared near 250M, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空，接近二百五十米處時望空。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (7W2W2W) Jumped well from the widest draw, raced slightly better than midfield on the outside, moved a bit closer after entering the back straight,2nd in the middle stages, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(7W2W2W) 自最外檔出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走外疊。入對面直路後略為追近。中段居第二位。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W) Pressed forward from a wide barrier to join race leader early in back straight, commenced move home bend and hit the front from tiring leader upon straightening, unable to sustain effort and swamped inside final 120M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前，在對面直路早段追上領放馬。直路彎開始上前。入直路時超越漸呈疲態的領放馬，取得領先。其後無以為繼，最後一百二十米被後上馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, weakened from the 300M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。自三百米處起轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Recovered quickly from moderate start to lead after the first 100M setting a sound pace, ceded advantage for 2nd spot onto home bend, remained prominent in 3rd into straight but folded up quickly inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘普通，迅速恢復走勢，過了首一百米後取得領先，以快步速領放。開始轉直路彎時被超越，居第二位。入直路時居前列第三位，但最後二百米迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, in control final 100m, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。二百米處加速帶離兩個馬位。最後一百米控制大局。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Pressed leader, quickened early to lead top of home straight, stayed on well, pressed by runner-up to line and just prevailed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。直路初加速，取得領先，保持佳勢。被亞軍馬匹追迫至終點，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, under pressure to hold position 500m out, never on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受催策以保持位置。從未能追上領先馬匹。

raceinfo_chi.Course: B 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run early in home straight, switched and hampered 250m out, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路早段須等待空位出現。二百五十米處轉換跑線及受阻礙。最後二百米以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W1W) Bumped on jumping, eased back to last from widest draw, still 8L to make up 400M but failed to make ground from the back. (Jockey - raced flat.)
(Lame in left front and right hind legs.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Lame in left front and right hind legs.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W1W) 自最外檔躍出時發生碰撞，收慢留居包尾位置。四百米處仍落後八個馬位，但未能自後列追前。（騎師表示，坐騎走勢平平。）
（左前腿及右後腿均不良於行。）
runnerrecords.healthissue_chi: （左前腿及右後腿均不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W3W) Settled well back, ran on well inside final 150M to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W3W) 遙居於後。最後一百五十米走勢良佳，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W5W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W5W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走外疊。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, moved smoothly into contention 400m out, stayed on well but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。四百米處順勢上前挑戰。保持佳勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W4W) Raced 3-wide in a position behind midfield, brought widest on straightening before closing off fastest to claim 3rd. Nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時走最外疊，末段衝刺最快，跑獲季軍。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken well back from the widest draw, snuck up on rail entering home straight, no clear run between the 300 and 200M and forced to steady and switch in for a run, finished off the race well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後留後，遙居後列。入直路時沿欄上前。三百米處至二百米處之間未能望空，被迫收慢及向內移入取位。末段以佳勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, improved and disputed led middle stages, headed by winner 150m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。中段上前，爭奪領先。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Ridden along at the back after moderate start, trailed the field and wide into straight, ran on strongly down the centre of the track to snatch 3rd final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 出閘普通，居後列，受催策。入直路時尾隨馬群，走外疊。在跑道中央走勢強勁，最後數步跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Across to press leader, ridden along 400m out to chase leader, stayed on well but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 切入以追迫領放馬。四百米處在催策下追趕領放馬。末段保持佳勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Raced wide without cover throughout, improved to press leader 700m out, pressed on 300m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 沿途在沒有遮擋下走外疊。七百米處推進以追迫領放馬。三百米處受催策，保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Across to press leader, pushed along to chase leader top of home straight, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 切入追迫領放馬。直路初受推策，追趕領放馬。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (2W3W) Tracked leaders, pushed along 450m out to chase leaders, unable to match winner but stayed on steadily, lost second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。四百五十米處受推策，追趕領先馬匹。未能追上頭馬，但保持穩勢。末段失去亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Away in line, stayed close enough to leaders, moved up to 2nd top of straight, responded well to take lead near 200M but couldn't hold off winner final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，保持落後領先馬匹不遠。直路初上前進佔第二位。對催策反應良佳，接近二百米處時取得領先，但末段未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Settled in rear from the widest barrier, commenced move in 10th 4-wide rounding home bend reaching 7th into straight, one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 自最外檔出閘，居後列。轉直路彎時居第十位，走第四疊，開始上前。入直路時進佔第七位，保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Waited with towards rear, some headway against rail in home straight, never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。直路上沿欄略為追前。從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, keen 1100m out, short of room early in home straight, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。千一米處搶口。直路早段空位不足。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, short-lived effort top of home straight, no extra final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。直路初一度發力。最後五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Guided to a rail spot in second half of the field, saved ground throughout the event, quickened up nicely passing 350M, led near 50M winning determinedly.
(Sustained a wound to the right knee.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a wound to the right knee.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 留居後半馬群中，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。跑過三百五十米處時加速良佳。接近五十米處時取得領先，在力拼下掄元。
（右膝有傷口。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Badly crowded and bumped at start, settled in rear of mid-field, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 起步時嚴重受擠迫，被碰撞。居中間之後位置。未能望空直至二百米處。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Chased leaders on the inside, fought on well enough passing 350M but was always held by first two final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 追趕領先馬匹，走內疊。跑過三百五十米處時以頗佳走勢力拼，但最後二百米一直落後頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W3W) Sat towards rear, made no impression in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W3W) 居後列。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) From draw 2 obtained a midfield position on settling, brought wide top of the straight before staying on mildly to take 3rd close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 自第二檔出閘，居中間位置。直路初移出外疊。其後保持普通走勢，接近終點時跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W) Jumped awkwardly losing ground settling in last few, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘笨拙，失地，居最後數位之內。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Jumped well, raced in midfield on the outside, 5 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走外疊。轉入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Crowded at start, rail position in rear of mid-field, ridden along 500m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Broke well, gradually settling just over 2L back in 4th on rail, saved ground turning in for home, one-paced without quickening under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，逐漸居第四位，落後稍逾兩個馬位，走內欄。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程。在催策下保持同速，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Driven along after the start but failed to show sufficient pace going forward, ended up racing behind mid-division, couldn't make up ground in the straight. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 起步後受催策，但未能展現足夠前速上前，居中間之後位置。直路上未能追前。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Went forward from draw 9 to race outside leader, soon took over on straightening, kicked nicely clear mid-straight and won decisively.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 自第九檔出閘後上前，居領放馬外側。入直路時瞬即取得領先。直路中段以佳勢加速帶離對手，以漂亮姿態勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W4W) Tracked leaders, taken wide into home straight, quickened early to lead 200m out but soon headed by winner, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時移出外疊。直路初加速，二百米處取得領先，但瞬即被頭馬超越。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Showed good early speed to lead, kept on nicely to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 早段展現甚快前速，取得領先。末段保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W2W) From a wide draw shifted across behind runners to the rail, raced ungenerously early stages, badly held up rounding the home bend, flashed home once clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W2W) 自外檔出閘後在馬群之後切入內欄。早段走勢欠順。轉直路彎時嚴重受困。末段望空後隨即以勁勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W) Ridden in first few early settling just over 1L off the pace in 3rd, gained 2nd 600M out 2-wide and hit the front over 200M out, hung on well under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W) 早段受催策，居前列第三位，落後領放馬稍逾一個馬位。六百米處進佔第二位，走第二疊。二百米處取得領先。在催策下保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, three wide into home straight, stayed on for pressure, couldn't quite reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時走第三疊。在催策下保持走勢，但未能真正追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, sat midfield, held up making the Turn, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置。轉直路彎時受困。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W) Raced very wide throughout, dropped to rear 700m out, bumped 400m out, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W) 沿途走大外疊。七百米處墮居後列。四百米處發生碰撞。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W) Jumped well, positioned a length behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped nicely, sat outside lead, ran on strongly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居領放馬外側。末段以勁勢上前，勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Commenced well from wide draw and across to lead, hung left under pressure home straight, headed 200m out, stuck to task but winner too strong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘迅速後切入領放。直路上在催策下外閃。二百米處被超越。持續力拼，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Sat on pace, traveled greenly, lay in throughout, difficult to be fully ridden out (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。走勢稚嫩。沿途內閃。難以被全力催策。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Quickly into stride, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on the inside, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬兩個馬位，走內疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W4W) Crowded start, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 wide from 650M, made minor progress in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W4W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間位置，走第二疊。自六百五十米處起走第三疊。直路上略為追前，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden along to chase leaders against rail 500m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策，沿欄追趕領先馬匹。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, had to wait for run top of home straight, clear run 250m out, strong run to lead 150m out, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路初須等待空位出現。二百五十米處望空。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Ridden from a middle barrier to vie for lead early, gaining 1L 2nd 4-wide onto first bend, soon came to tackle leader in home straight and hit the front 300M out only to be outsprinted 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 自中檔出閘後受催策，早段爭奪領先。開始轉首個彎位時進佔第二位，落後一個馬位，走第四疊。直路上瞬即上前挑戰領放馬。三百米處取得領先，僅於一百五十米處被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped with them, sent forward to race in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, kept on well in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, positioned 1-1/4L behind the leader on rail, easy run to turn, showed good response in straight, took the lead 150M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner close home.
(Sustained a small wound to the right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a small wound to the right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬一又四分一個馬位，走內欄。直路彎前走勢輕鬆。直路上對催策反應良佳。一百五十米處取得領先。末段保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭馬。
（右後腿有一個細小傷口。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, blundered near 850M, angled out 450M, kept on well in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。接近八百五十米處時失蹄。四百五十米處向外移出。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W2W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, kept on well early in straight, outpaced 200M, stayed on evenly to take 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W2W) 起步時向內斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間之前位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。直路初保持佳勢。二百米處被拋離。保持穩勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W3W2W) Slightly slow out settling in last few, baulked for a run most of the way in home straight, produced late impression inside final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W3W2W) 出閘稍慢，居最後數位之內。直路上大部分途程受困。最後五十米追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled in last few on rail, switched out early in home straight but soon ran out of room inside the 200M, made no impression thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居最後數位之內，走內欄。直路早段向外移出，但二百米處瞬即空位不足。其後毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Began only fairly, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground throughout, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。沿途走內疊節省腳程。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Jumped fairly, ended up racing in a rearward spot 6-7Ls off leader, ran on moderately in the straight but not able to trouble leaders.
(Jockey dropped whip at 550M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘一般，居後列，落後領放馬六至七個馬位。直路上略為追前，但未能威脅領先馬匹。
（於五百五十米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （於五百五十米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W4W) In rear after crowded at start, taken wider final bend, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列。直路彎移出較外疊。未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W2W) Settled towards the rear on the rail after a sluggish start, travelled okay throughout, failed to show his usual turn of foot with good pace up front.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，走內欄。沿途走勢尚可。賽事步速偏快，未能展現慣常加速力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W3W) Began only fairly, raced towards rear on the inside, angled out 500M, very wide turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時走大外疊。直路上毫無進展。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 5-year-old gelding, by Written Tycoon out of the Show A Heart mare Heart Of Thrills. Horses by the same sire include Tomodachi Kokoroe and Sing Dragon. This fellow had one start for one win (a maiden over 1400m). He was given seven trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished seventh, beaten by 6-1/4Ls, under the whip, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on November 2. He is probably not looking like a first-up winner but this race will give is a chance to look at him more closely.
formguide.comments_chi: 「千秋巨子」(Written Tycoon)之後，在港同父馬包括「好友心得」及「昇瀧駒」等駒，生母Heart Of Thrills出自「表心意」(Show A Heart)。來港前在澳洲一出一捷，頭馬為一場1400米從未勝出馬賽。抵港後試閘七次。最近11月2日出試從化草地1200米，早段居中，末段鞭策下跑第七名，落後頭馬6.25個馬位。不似能一出即勝，觀望為宜。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W4W) In last few despite ridden early dropping to last 800M out, swung widest into home straight, ran on past well-beaten runners near the stands side without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W4W) 儘管早段受催策，仍居最後數位之內。八百米處墮居包尾位置。入直路時走最外疊。末段靠近外欄競跑，超越已洩氣潰敗的對手，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W2W3W) Settled mainly towards rear in 8th travelling keenly at times, shifted wide for a run into home straight, ran on well down the centre of the track to snatch 2nd late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W2W3W) 大多居後列第八位，不時搶口。入直路時移出外疊以取位。沿跑道中央以佳勢上前，末段取得亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, dropped out from widest draw, pushed along widest into home straight, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W) 自最外檔出閘時發生碰撞，墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W4W) Unable to slot in from wide draw, caught wide in midfield and left without cover from 600M, ran home well enough final 300M to be beaten 1.5L at the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W4W) 自大外檔出閘，未能切入內疊，居中間位置，走外疊。自六百米處起沒有遮擋。最後三百米衝刺良佳，過終點時以一個半馬位之差見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初對催策反應平平。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Chased leaders in 3rd, fought hard to stay in contention on straightening, couldn't keep up with leaders final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 追趕領先馬匹，居第三位。入直路時力拼以保持爭逐機會。最後一百五十米未能跟上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W3W) Caught wide no cover early stages, strode forward to settle outside the lead, in 3rd spot making home turn but didn't have much left in tank on straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W3W) 早段走外疊，沒有遮擋。展步上前居領放馬外側。轉直路彎時居第三位，入直路時無甚餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (4W2W2W) Jumped best from a wide barrier to gain slender lead off the rail, steadied up inside the 900M to be just under 1L back 2-wide, in similar position into straight but could only keep on at the same pace under pressure.

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Ridden along from a wide barrier, soon drifted backward to 3-wide with cover in midfield, commenced move entering home straight, ran on dourly under pressure to claim 2nd inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 自外檔出閘後受催策，瞬即墮後居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。進入直路時開始上前。最後一百米在催策下力拼，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, kept on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Started well and across from wide draw to track leading pair, moved smoothly to front 200m out, winner too strong final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，切入跟隨領先兩駒。走勢暢順，二百米處取得領先。最後五十米不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (4W2W2W) Jumped well from gate 10, raced prominently on the outside, 1/2L back turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked on run 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(4W2W2W) 自第十檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。轉入直路時落後半個馬位。直路初保持佳勢，一百五十米處未能再增速。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Chased leader, stayed on for clear second but never quite able to challenge winner.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 追趕領放馬。保持走勢，跑獲亞軍，帶離餘駒，但從未能真正挑戰頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Ridden forward from wide stall, tracked leading pair, loomed up to lead 200m out, ran on well to line but headed close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後受催策上前，跟隨領先兩駒。二百米處上前領放。保持佳勢至終點，但接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W2W) 起步緩慢，居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策。入直路時轉換跑線以望空。最後二百米走勢強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Not hurried and raced in second half of the field throughout in a fast run race, urged along 450M, picked up well to challenge for the lead mid-straight but no match for winner late.

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W2W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, briefly hampered 1600m out, shuffled back mid-race, wide into home straight, no impression.

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good(-) (3W3W2W2W) Obtained a midfield spot on settling, travelled well to the straight, didn't have the clearest run in particular final 150m to 50M. Lost 3rd close home.

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W3W4W) From wide draw taken back to last, switched to 3-wide from halfway and made headway from 700M, wide into straight before staying on for 2nd. No match for runaway winner.

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on but no further impression on front two late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段保持走勢，但未能進一步威脅頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Settled midfield, traveled nicely, made good ground inside 200M.

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W5W) From wide draw eased back to race in a rearward position, driven wide into the home straight, ran on steadily but was always held by first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W5W) 自外檔出閘，收慢留後，居後列。入直路時在催策下走外疊。走勢平穩，但一直落後頭四名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W4W) Settled in mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, strong run to lead 100m out, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。走勢強勁，一百米處取得領先。帶離對手勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in 5th 2Ls away, travelled well with little change to the turn, right there at the 300M, gave good response to be joining leader 100M and just prevailed in a game effort.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居第五位，落後兩個馬位。直路彎前走勢良佳，居相若位置。三百米處居好位，對催策反應良佳，一百米處追上領放馬。在力拼下僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W3W3W3W) Caught racing wide no cover in midfield, moved forward to be closer to leaders back straight, loomed up top of the straight, fought hard but only maintained the position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。對面直路上上前，追近領先馬匹。直路初上前。力拼，但僅能保持位置。

runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之前位置，落後領放馬約三個馬位。直路早段追前至第三位。末段力拼，但最後二百米的衝刺不及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W3W) Tracked leaders against rail, travelled smoothly to 400m out, shifted left early in home straight, stayed on steadily.

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Tracked leaders, quickened 400m out to lead 250m out, ran on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處加速，二百五十米處取得領先。走勢良佳，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Shifted in at start and bumped, positioned 2 wide, 2 lengths back, same position on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened inside final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
