runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, under pressure 600m out, one paced and unable to get on terms with winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處受催策。保持同速，未能追上頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped well from gate 11, raced prominently on the outside, 1/2L back turning in, challenged the leader early in straight, peaked on run near 200M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 自第十一檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後半個馬位。直路早段挑戰領放馬。接近二百米處時未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W3W3W) Chased leader, remained prominent 900m out, switched and under pressure 500m out, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W3W3W) 追趕領放馬。九百米處保持居前列。五百米處轉換跑線，受催策。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Began well from a wide draw, sent forward to race prominently on the outside, took the lead after passing 850M, led by 1/4L turning in, peaked and headed 300M, weakened final 200M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。跑過八百五十米處後取得領先。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。三百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Led steadily, kept finding when challenged by rivals in the straight, couldn't hold off winner passing 150M but continued bravely to hold 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 以平穩步速領放。直路上受對手挑戰時持續力拼。跑過一百五十米處時未能抗衡頭馬，但繼續奮勇力拼，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W2W) Prominent, ridden to chase leader 500m out, struggled to hold position in home straight, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W2W) 居前列。五百米處受催策追趕領放馬。直路上難以保持位置。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W2W2W) Tracked pace, improved to race outside of leader before halfway, led 400m out, headed 200m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。半程前推進至領放馬外側。四百米處取得領先。二百米處被超越，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Soon took up running from draw 2 and had a soft lead throughout, came under siege 300M and gave ground mid-straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自第二檔出閘，瞬即取得領先。沿途輕鬆領放。三百米處受到挑戰。直路中段墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W2W2W) Went forward tracking leader, pace slow middle stages, led 300M out before keeping on well to hold rivals at bay. (Trainer attributed the improved performance being up in distance and being able to race on the pace.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W2W2W) 上前跟隨領放馬。賽事中段步速緩慢。三百米處取得領先，其後保持佳勢，力拒對手勝出。（練馬師將此駒的進步表現歸因於增程角逐，並能夠居前競跑。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled well behind on rail after beginning from a wide barrier, travelled keenly from 1300M out while trailing the field on rail, detached early in straight but ran past well-beaten runners under pressure inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後遙居於後，走內欄。自千三米處起搶口，沿欄尾隨馬群。直路初被拋離，但最後一百五十米在催策下超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Jumped with them, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, carried wider 550M, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。五百五十米處被帶出較外疊。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W4W3W) Restrained to a position behind midfield, raced keenly early stages, had some work to do tuning home but gave only limited response. Never threatened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W4W3W) 在約束下居中間之後位置，早段搶口。轉入直路時落後頗遠，但對催策反應平平。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Reserved behind midfield early stages, shuffled back to the rear entering home turn, failed to run on final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 早段留居中間之後位置。進入直路彎時墮居後列。最後四百米未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Bumped at start, unable to shift near the rail until taken back to rear 2-wide approaching the winning post the first time, remained towards rear to straight, tightened badly inside the 150M, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 起步時被碰撞，未能移近內欄。首次趨近終點時留居後列，走第二疊。直路前仍居後列。最後一百五十米嚴重受緊迫。末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Towards rear most of the way, ran on past well-beaten horses inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 大部分途程居後列。最後二百米上前超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W1W2W) Waited with towards rear, shuffled back mid-race, pushed along widest into home straight, struggling.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W1W2W) 居後列，留力待上。中段墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。掙扎上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Waited with towards rear, keen early stages, pushed along wide into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居後列，留力待上。早段搶口。入直路時受推策，走外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good(-) (2W2W3W4W) Jumped only fairly, settled in second half of the field before moving closer to leaders from 700M, wide into straight and kept finding to grab a minor placing.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速(-)(2W2W3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後半馬群中。其後自七百米處起追近領先馬匹。入直路時走外疊。持續力拼，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W3W) Raced in rear after crowded at start, still in last pair top of home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W3W) 起步後受擠迫，居後列。直路初仍居最後兩位之內，未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Jumped well from gate 1, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on rail, 2 wide turning in, made good progress early in straight, peaked 100M, weakened gradually close home.
(Sustained a laceration to the left front cannon.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a laceration to the left front cannon.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬三個馬位，走內欄。入直路時走第二疊。直路初追前甚多。一百米處未能再增速。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。
（左前腿管骨部位割傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W6W) Sluggish start, dropped out from widest draw, pushed along widest into home straight, stayed on but no further impression close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W6W) 自大外檔起步緩慢，墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。保持走勢，但接近終點時再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W3W4W) Gradually settled towards rear racing 3-wide with cover down back straight, swung one of the widest turning in for home, ran on dourly under pressure to claim victory close to post.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 對面直路上逐漸居後列，走第三疊，有遮擋。轉入直路時向外移出，為走最外疊的馬匹之一。在催策下持續力拼，接近終點時取得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W4W) Settled down in midfield along the 2-path, driven wide into straight, couldn't sustain run passing 250M and weakened. (Jockey - horse lay out in the home straight. / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時受催策，走外疊。跑過二百五十米處時無以為繼，轉弱。（騎師表示，坐騎在直路上外閃。）（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Soon taken across from a poor draw for rails run in midfield in 7th some 4L off the pace, gained slightly closer to 6th in back straight, saved ground turning in for home, ran on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後瞬即切入內欄取位，居中間第七位，落後領放馬約四個馬位。對面直路上略為追近至第六位。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程。以穩勢上前，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W1W2W) Sat towards rear, tailed-off most of the way, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W1W2W) 居後列。大部分途程居包尾位置。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Settled down midfield in a fast run race, came with a decent finish passing 300M, just couldn't hold off winner late stages in a race won at class record time.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 在快步速下居中間位置。跑過三百米處時衝刺不俗。僅於末段未能抗衡以刷新班次紀錄的時間取勝的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slowly away, raced at rear on the inside, last turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，走內疊。入直路時居包尾位置。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Stuck to inside rail throughout, mid-field, clear run in home straight, stayed on to edge ahead final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，沿途固守內欄。直路上望空。保持走勢，最後五十米取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Began awkwardly and made heavy contact, raced better than midfield on rail, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, bumped 200M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，與對手互相大力觸碰，居中間之前位置，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。二百米處發生碰撞。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Began well, raced better than midfield on the inside, 3 lengths back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W) Reserved in midfield along the fence 3-4Ls back, in similar position turning home, ran on well final 300M, nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W) 沿欄留居中間位置，落後三至四個馬位。轉直路彎時居相若位置。最後三百米以佳勢上前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Began well, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Jumped with them, raced slightly better than midfield on the outside, 3 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, settled in rear of mid-field, tight for room early in home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置。直路初空位不足。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) From draw 1 got away well, reserved in mid-division in a fast run race, put in a moderate effort passing 300M and never going the pace to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，在快步速下留居中間位置。跑過三百米處時略為上前，從未能加速上前挑戰領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Up with early pace before easing back to race ahead of mid-division, kept on at the same pace final 300M without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 早段與領放馬並跑，繼而留居中間之前位置。最後三百米保持同速，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W2W) Sat handy, traveled smoothly, made good ground under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居前列，走勢暢順。在鞭策下追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W2W) Sent forward from wide draw and raced outside of leader, in share of lead from 400m out, every chance until no extra final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後受催策上前，居領放馬外側。自四百米處起並排領先。一度甚具爭勝機會，但最後五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) In touch with leaders early, drifted back into mid-field back straight, when also checked briefly, stayed on under pressure final 300m, moved into third 75m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 早段跟隨領先馬匹。對面直路上墮居中間位置，一度勒避。最後三百米在催策下保持走勢。七十五米處進佔第三位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Raced 4 wide no cover midfield, under pressure from the 600M, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，走第四疊，沒有遮擋。自六百米處起受催策。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Recovered steadily on rail to 3L 6th about 1200M out after moderate start, drifted 5L back in midfield rounding home bend, one-paced under pressure in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，其後逐漸恢復走勢，約千二米處居第六位，落後三個馬位，走內欄。轉直路彎時墮後五個馬位，居中間位置。直路上在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (1W1W1W1W) Sat on pace, traveled smoothly, responded nicely under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 跟前競跑，走勢暢順。在鞭策下反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (3W3W3W2W) Settled on pace 3 wide no cover, traveled nicely, made steady progress under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(3W3W3W2W) 居前競跑，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。走勢良佳。在鞭策下穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W3W2W) Sent forward from high draw and raced wide, tracked leader, improved into share of lead turning into home straight, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W3W2W) 自大外檔出閘後受催策上前，跟隨領放馬，走外疊。轉入直路時上前，並排領先。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W1W1W) Mid division, ridden top of home straight, challenged up rail from 200m out, ran on well to close on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W1W1W) 居中間位置。直路初受催策。自二百米處起沿內欄展開挑戰，以佳勢追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W2W2W) Raced wide, tracked pace, forward move halfway to race outside of leader, unable to stay with that rival, one paced under pressure home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W2W2W) 走外疊，跟隨領放馬。半程時上前居領放馬外側競跑，其後未能跟上該駒。直路上在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on in a close finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W1W) 受催策上前領放。在多駒幾乎齊過終點下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Settled handy, traveled nicely, pressed on rounding the Turn, responded well when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居前列，走勢良佳。轉直路彎時受催策。末段對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Taken back from gate 12, raced at rear on the inside, 6 lengths or so back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自第十二檔出閘後留居後列，走內疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) From wide draw dropped back to race near the rear early, improved to midfield passing 1000M when pace slackened, asked for maximum effort 400M but only held ground in a steady run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 自最外檔出閘，早段墮居後列。跑過一千米處賽事步速減慢時推進至中間位置。四百米處受全力催策，但末段走勢平穩，僅能保持位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W3W) Sat towards the rear 3 wide, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W3W) 居後列，走第三疊。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Bumped on jumping, raced 2 wide at rear, angled out after passing 500M, no daylight early in straight, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 躍出時與對手互相碰撞，居後列，走第二疊。跑過五百米處後向外移出。直路早段未能望空，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W5W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 3 wide with cover towards rear, a bit closer in the middle stages, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W5W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走第三疊，有遮擋。中段略為追近。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前頗多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide behind midfield, there to turn, difficult to obtain clear run early in straight, cleared after passing 250M, made minor progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段難以望空。跑過二百五十米處後望空，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Dropped back to the rear on jumping from a wide draw, had a ground saving trip on the inside, had some work to do 400M, closed off fastest to finish a close 5th, nearest at the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮居包尾位置，走內疊節省腳程。四百米處仍落後頗遠。末段衝刺最快，取得第五名。過終點時最為接近。

raceinfo_chi.Course: B 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (1W1W1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 受催策上前，取得領先。保持走勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Caught wide early stages before continuing forward to lead the event, maintained narrow lead in the straight, fought hard but was caught by first two late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 早段走外疊，其後持續上前領放。直路上保持以短距離領先。力拼，但末段被頭兩名馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W4W) Began awkwardly from wide draw then dropped back to race in last spot over 10Ls off leader, still in clear last top of the straight, ran past well beaten horses only.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W4W) 自最外檔出閘笨拙，其後墮居包尾位置，落後領放馬逾十個馬位。直路初仍遙居包尾位置。末段僅能超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Taken back to near last on jumping from wide draw, raced keenly in middle stages, 5-6Ls off leader home turn but failed to quicken. Never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居接近包尾位置。中段搶口。直路彎落後領放馬五至六個馬位，但未能加速。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, pushed along final bend to chase leaders, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路彎受推策以追趕領先馬匹。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Chased the pace on the inside, pushed along 500M to keep up the chase on leader, couldn't get any closer final 150M, lost 3rd near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 追趕領放馬，走內疊。五百米處受推策以持續追趕領放馬。最後一百五十米未能再追近，接近終點時失去第三位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W3W) Jumped with them, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide on turn, angled out 500M, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders, short of room in home straight, clear run 100m out, lost all chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路上空位不足。一百米處望空。再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Hampered at start dropping to last few, came under pressure over 500M out to challenge into the straight, found nothing under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 起步時受阻礙，墮居最後數位之內。五百米處受催策以在入直路時展開挑戰。在催策下再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W3W) Settled in last few after a moderate start and waited with in 8th some 6L off the pace, commenced move approaching home turn and finished off the race well inside final 150M, did beset work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘普通，其後居後列第八位，落後領放馬約六個馬位，留力候上。趨近直路彎時開始上前。最後一百五十米衝刺良佳。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Crowded at start, raced in touch with leaders, followed runner-up through 600m out, hung in but ran on strongly to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 起步時受擠迫，跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處跟隨亞軍馬匹上前。末段內閃，但衝刺強勁。接近終點時取得領先，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, followed winner through 400m out, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處跟隨頭馬上前。走勢良佳，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Moderately away from gate 1, positioned a length behind the leader, 2 wide turning in, kept on very well in straight, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘普通，落後領放馬一個馬位。入直路時走第二疊。直路上保持甚佳走勢，僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the outside, moved closer after passing 1000M, 1-1/2L back turning in, showed good response in straight, challenged the leader 150M, bumped 100M, kept on well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走外疊。跑過一千米處後追近。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路上對催策反應良佳。一百五十米處挑戰領放馬。一百米處與對手互相碰撞。保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W1W2W) Jumped cleanly, settled midfield 6th 4-5Ls off leader, could not improve turning for home and battled on fairly for minor money.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W1W2W) 出閘俐落，居中間第六位，落後領放馬四至五個馬位。轉直路彎時未能推進上前。末段以不俗走勢力拼，取得第六名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Went forward from a wide draw and obtained a position outside the leader, gained narrow lead 350M, kept battling but was outpaced by rivals final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後上前，居領放馬外側。三百五十米處以短距離領先。持續力拼，但最後一百五十米被對手拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Settled back in the field in a race being run outside of standard time, failed to run on in the home straight. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 居後列，賽事步速較標準時間為慢。直路上未能追前。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W2W2W2W) Not hurried early stages, dropped back to a rearward spot 5-6Ls off the pace, ran on well final 300M to be nearest at the line. Just missed out on 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W2W2W2W) 早段未受催策，墮退至後列，落後領放馬五至六個馬位。最後三百米走勢良佳，過終點時最為接近，僅失季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, strong run final 200m to lead 50m out, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。最後二百米衝刺強勁，五十米處取得領先，帶離對手勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) From a wide draw given a conservative ride at the rear early stages, held up on the home turn behind a weakening rival before running on well to take 3rd close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，早段居後列，留後競跑。直路彎時在轉弱的對手之後受困。其後以佳勢上前，接近終點時進佔第三位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Mid-division, forward move wide on bend, upsides leaders and in contention 200m out, unable to sustain effort.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。直路彎上前，走外疊。二百米處上前追逼領先馬匹，具爭逐機會，但末段無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, tracked leader, pushed along to challenge leaders 450m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領放馬。四百五十米處受推策以挑戰領先馬匹。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W1W2W) Sat handy, traveled nicely, made good ground inside 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W1W2W) 居前列。走勢良佳。最後二百米追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W3W2W) Made contact shortly after start, taken back to race at tail, 6 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W3W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W5W) Mid division, switched wide with cover 800m out, pushed along wide into home straight, strong run to lead 150m out, stayed on well to hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W5W) 居中間位置。八百米處移出外疊，有遮擋。入直路時受推策，走外疊。衝刺強勁，一百五十米處取得領先，保持佳勢，保住勝局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W3W4W) Stayed close to leaders but raced wide without cover for the majority of the race, hard driven from 450M, responded well to be challenging for the lead final stages, held by first two at the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W3W4W) 緊隨領先馬匹，但大部分途程走外疊，沒有遮擋。自四百五十米處起受力策，反應良佳。末段爭奪領先，過終點時落後首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W2W) Away well, raced better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, made contact near 400M, no clear early in straight, cleared approaching 200M, kept on well until final 50M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。接近四百米處時與對手互相觸碰。直路初未能望空。趨近二百米處時望空。保持佳勢直至五十米處。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W4W) Ridden along from stalls to track leaders, chased leaders 450m out, one paced and unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W4W) 出閘後受催策，跟隨領先馬匹。四百五十米處追趕領先馬匹。保持同速，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Crowded and forced to steady exiting stalls, raced in rear, still in rear top of home straight, eye-catching headway from rear final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘時受擠迫，被迫收慢，居後列。直路初仍居後列。最後二百米自後列追前，走勢悅目。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W4W) Held up last, lost balance and lost ground 800m out, pushed along widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W4W) 留居包尾位置。八百米處失去平衡及失地。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W3W) Taken back from wide draw and settled near last in a steadily run race, had 5Ls to make up 400M but responded only fairly. (Jockey - better suited by being stepped up in distance.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W3W) 自外檔出閘，留居接近包尾位置，賽事步速平穩。四百米處落後五個馬位，但對催策反應僅屬一般。（騎師表示，坐騎增程角逐應適合發揮。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Waited with in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, lacked pace to reach leaders.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。速度不足以追及領先馬匹。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow(+) (1W1W1W2W) Sat last, stayed on fairly. (See Incident Report)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居包尾位置。保持一般走勢。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) Waited with in rear, saved ground against rail final bend, strong run to lead final 50m, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。走勢強勁，最後五十米取得領先，其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Stumbled leaving stalls, rail position in rear of mid-field, travelled smoothly into home straight, strong run final 200m to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 出閘時失蹄，居中間之後位置，走內欄。入直路時走勢暢順。最後二百米走勢強勁，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Sat towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made steady progress under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列。走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。在鞭策下穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Waited with towards rear, still in rear top of home straight, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍居後列。未能望空直至二百米處。最後二百米以佳勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Waited with in rear, blocked off when going for run 350m out, clear run 300m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。三百五十米處取位時受困。三百米處望空，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out after passing 400M, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。跑過四百米處後向外移出。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, found daylight near 200M, finished off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。接近二百米處時望空，末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced towards rear on the outside, similar position on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, kept on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 起步時向內斜跑，發生觸碰，居後列，走外疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路初略為追前，一百五十米處未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Waited with in rear, pushed along 600m out, stayed on but never going pace to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。六百米處受推策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以挑戰領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Dropped back to the rear, raced keenly with the pace of the event being run outside of standard time, 10Ls off leader 400M, couldn't make up ground.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(2W3W) 墮居後列，搶口，賽事步速較標準時間為慢。四百米處落後領放馬十個馬位。未能追前。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W4W) In rear after crowded and steadied at start, pushed along widest into home straight, closed on winner late on but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W4W) 起步時受擠迫及收慢，其後居後列。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sluggish start, settled in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, ran on strongly final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步緩慢，居中間位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。最後一百米衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Dropped back to race in last from a wide draw, moved closer 600M, unleashed a strong turn of foot on straightening to take lead 200M, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自大外檔出閘後墮居包尾位置。六百米處追近。入直路時加速強勁，二百米處取得領先。帶離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, shuffled back, still in last place turning into home straight, strong run final 200m, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W1W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列。轉入直路時仍居包尾位置。最後二百米衝刺強勁，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, positioned 2 wide, 2 lengths or so back, 3 wide after passing 550M, same margin back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久被碰撞，落後約兩個馬位，走第二疊。跑過五百五十米處後走第三疊。入直路時落後相同距離。直路早段對催策反應平平，最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W2W) Held a forward position outside leader, right there turning for home but peaked on his run mid-straight and failed to finish the job.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側的前列位置。轉直路彎時居好位，但直路中段未能再增速。末段未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Settled 2-wide ahead of midfield, in touch making the turn for home, stayed on mildly towards the finish and just lost out in a photo finish for 3rd and 4th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。轉直路彎時居啣接位置。保持一般走勢至終點，在電眼判決下僅失季軍及第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Away well, positioned 2 wide, 2-1/2L back, same position on turn, showed very good response in straight, took the lead approaching 50M, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，落後兩個半馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路上對催策反應甚佳。趨近五十米處時取得領先。帶離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, travelled smoothly to 350m out, strong run to lead 200m out, won comfortably and going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W2W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹。三百五十米處前走勢暢順。衝刺強勁，二百米處取得領先。帶離對手，輕鬆取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Chased leaders on the inside, held up making the home turn and early straight, obtained clear running passing 250M and closed off well enough to take 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 追趕領先馬匹，走內疊。轉直路彎時及直路初受困。跑過二百五十米處時望空。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, raised tempo 800m out, kicked 400m out, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 前速甚快，取得領先。八百米處加快步速。四百米處加速。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 3 wide with cover towards rear, wider turning in, steadied approaching 350M, made good progress thereafter to be nearest on line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居後列，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走更外疊。趨近三百五十米處時收慢。其後追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (3W4W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, good headway on bend to lead 600m out, headed 300m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎追前甚多，六百米處取得領先。三百米處被超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Settled towards rear, made a mid-race move near 1100M, gave ground quickly in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居後列。中段接近千一米處時發力上前。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W2W2W) Failed to show sufficient pace to hold a more forward position and settled behind midfield 6Ls off leader, had some work to do 400M but failed to come into the race.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W2W2W) 未能展現足夠前速以佔取更為靠前的位置，居中間之後位置，落後領放馬六個馬位。四百米處仍落後頗遠，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W) Sent to the lead under 7lb claimer, raced keenly and did not settle which resulted in the early and middle stages being run inside of standard time, headed nearing 200M then weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 由獲讓七磅的見習騎師策騎，受催策上前領放。搶口及未能穩定走勢，導致賽事早段及中段的步速較標準時間為快。接近二百米處時被超越，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W3W) Caught wide early stages, retrained to a rear spot settled further back than intended, had some work to do 400M but made only limited progress to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 早段走外疊，其後受約束以居較賽前部署為後的後列位置。四百米處落後頗遠，但末段僅能略為上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, ridden along final bend, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎受催策。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Settled in mid-field, commenced move out wide 800m out, sustained headway to join leader 200m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。八百米處開始上前，走外疊。持續追前，二百米處追上領放馬。末段持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊，未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field with cover, followed runner-up through 500m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。五百米處跟隨亞軍馬匹上前。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Crowded start, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上追前頗多，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled mainly in rear of midfield on rail, found no extra inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 大多居中間之後位置，走內欄。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back from the outside barrier, sat at the rear, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) From wide draw obtained a midfield position, 3Ls off the pace 400M, worked home evenly in the run home for 4th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 自大外檔出閘，居中間位置。四百米處落後領放馬三個馬位。末段保持穩勢，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W4W) Raced keenly early stages, eased back to settle near last, headway from 700M along the 3-path, stayed on mildly over final 300M under top weight although never a winning hope.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W4W) 早段搶口，收慢留居接近包尾位置。自七百米處起追前，走第三疊。負最重磅下在最後三百米保持普通走勢，但從未具勝望。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W3W3W3W) Settled behind midfield early before moving closer to leaders down the back straight, in 5th spot making home turn, showed plenty of dash from 300M, powered away final stages to win stylishly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W3W3W3W) 早段居中間之後位置，對面直路上追近領先馬匹。轉直路彎時居第五位。自三百米處起追前甚多。末段衝刺強勁，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W4W) Jumped awkwardly, raced behind midfield on the outside, commenced move 500M, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走外疊。五百米處開始上前。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。衝刺凌厲，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) From draw 2 stayed close enough to early pace before settling back in midfield along the inside, held up for clear running making the home turn, crowded for room near 200M and not able to be ridden out to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第二檔出閘，早段居接近領放馬的位置，其後留居中間位置，走內疊。轉直路彎時受困而未能望空。接近二百米處時受擠迫，未能被全力催策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Jumped awkward but soon in first few settling over 2L back in 4th 2-wide, came under pressure from 500M out swinging wide into straight, ran on steadily under pressure to hold every only to be outsprinted late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘笨拙，但瞬即進佔前列第四位，落後逾兩個馬位，走第二疊。自五百米處起受催策，入直路時移出外疊。在催策下保持穩勢，已獲機會盡展所長，末段僅被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, sat towards rear, held up making the Home Turn, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。轉直路彎時受困。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W3W3W) Made contact shortly after start, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover for the majority of the race, made some progress in straight to make frame, no threat to the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W3W3W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間位置，走外疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路上略為追前，取得第四名，但未能對前列馬匹構成威脅。
